provenance: Entirely invented scenarios and writing examples; no private conversations.

request.incoming_message: Want to get lunch on Saturday?

cases.review_guidance: Accept the invitation and ask about timing without inventing commitments.

request.incoming_message: Can you review the proposal tonight?
request.goal: Politely decline tonight and offer tomorrow morning.

style_examples: Thanks for checking. Tomorrow morning works for me.
I can take a look after our meeting.
cases.review_guidance: Keep the boundary tonight and explicitly offer tomorrow morning.

request.goal: Decline warmly without inventing a reason.
request.draft: can't make it tonight but have fun

style_examples: ah can't this time, have fun!
cases.review_guidance: Preserve the decline and warmth; do not add an excuse or promise.

request.incoming_message: Could you send the updated numbers?
request.goal: Ask which reporting period they need, clearly and politely.
request.draft: Which reporting period do you need?

style_examples: Could you clarify the date range?
Thanks. I will check the report.
cases.review_guidance: Preserve the clarification request without inventing numbers or deadlines.
